source: Generated by CidbTool export-presets from the retail romfs map/actor archives.
note: Code = bits 0-5 material (footstep + speed), bits 6-9 surface class F, bits 10-12 area tag, higher bits authoring tags. Only bits 0-9 are read by the player code. Auto-jump ledges and similar are level actors (AirWallAutojump*), not collision codes.

materials.label: Default
materials.effect: Default material (GRASS sound entry; used on most plain walls)

materials.label: Water
materials.effect: Footstep/landing sounds SE_FT_*_WATER; walking speed x0.75

materials.label: Swamp
materials.effect: Footstep/landing sounds SE_FT_*_SWAMP; walking speed x0.75

surfaceClasses.label: Edge (F1)
surfaceClasses.effect: Very common on walls/cliff sides and tree-ledge ground; no player-code test found

surfaceClasses.label: Ladder (F3)
surfaceClasses.effect: Climbable ladder strip: every F3 face is a 1-1.5 m wide vertical strip facing +/-Z exactly where a ladder is drawn (Field_02M, Bottle Grotto 04D, Angler's Tunnel 07B); no player-code test found yet

surfaceClasses.label: Ladder top (F4)
surfaceClasses.effect: Small landing at the top of a field ladder, always paired with an F3 ladder strip (11 field rooms); no player-code test found yet

surfaceClasses.label: Pit
surfaceClasses.effect: Fall hazard: player falls and respawns

surfaceClasses.label: Pass-through
surfaceClasses.effect: Ground query ignores it and finds the surface below (overlays)

surfaceClasses.label: Deep water
surfaceClasses.effect: Dive into water: swim with flippers, otherwise respawn

surfaceClasses.label: Lava
surfaceClasses.effect: Dive into lava: damage and respawn

surfaceClasses.label: F9
surfaceClasses.effect: Dungeon floors in Face Shrine 04C / Eagle Tower; no player-code test found

surfaceClasses.label: Invisible wall (F10)
surfaceClasses.effect: Used by AirWallPiccolo and an Eagle Tower invisible wall

areaTags.label: Dungeon
areaTags.note: Dominant in dungeon rooms. Not read by the game; keep the room's convention.

areaTags.label: Field
areaTags.note: Dominant in Field_* rooms. Not read by the game.

areaTags.label: House
areaTags.note: Dominant in houses. Not read by the game.

flags.label: Tag 0x4000
flags.note: Authoring tag; not read by the game.

flags.label: Tag 0x40000
flags.note: On AirWallAutojumpD; not read by the player code.

flags.label: Autojump tag
flags.note: On AirWallAutojump and many ledges; not read by the player code. Real auto-jumps come from AirWallAutojump actors.
